resources.limits: Runner database isolated; PostgreSQL service/host shared with normal stack. No competing test/build workload; normal stack CPU load not instrumented.

policy.late_emission: Never emit after the arrival window; count as not emitted
policy.final_pending: Classify as failed/timeout at fixed drain deadline
policy.emission: Async coroutine begins whole HTTP transaction, before connection/open/read; event-loop scheduling wait included in generator delay
policy.justification: 20rps gives 50ms intervals: p95 jitter 1/5 interval, p99 1/2 interval, max two intervals; zero missing arrivals preserves full18000. Drain70s=timeout65s+5s margin.
policy.request_timeout_scope: 65s total across connection, headers and body
policy.client_concurrency: No pending-request cap; per-request65s timeout bounds outstanding lifetime
